eventName: Sri Pavalavannar Perumal Temple pond Cleaning work
eventDescription:
The cleaning of the pond outside the Pavalavanna Perumal Temple, one of the 108 Divya Desams near Kanchipuram New Railway Station, is going to be held today, Saturday, 14/06/2025 at 10 am,

This event is being held by the Seed Volunteer Organization, which has been continuously providing various services in Kanchipuram district, and the work of maintaining this pond is going to be done by the college students, school students, service organizations, volunteers, Kanchipuram Corporation cleaning workers,

Everyone is required to participate in this event. Our ancestors have created a huge water source. We should use that water source properly and provide it to the next generations. The people of that area can also participate in this event with the good intention of coming happily and doing good,
